items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I used to play certain parties and dances for him... I played a whole summer while school was at recess.

ctx.x: Well, there (inaudible) used to be a band leader there. I can't recall his name right now. It may come to me later. He used to play out the "Tuxedo Junction". George Uge was the name.

George Uge. He was a drummer. He used to come to my house and pick me up. My mother would let me go. And, we used to, I used to play certain parties and dances for him. During the summertime, I was out to Tuxedo Junction. I played a whole summer while school was at recess. And then, I got a lot of opportunities to do those things with those musicians. I didn't get too much other training, you know. Just myself.
